proposal.summary: An unauthenticated CGI script on the D-Link DSR-250N (affected version 3.12) can be invoked remotely to reboot the device, causing a denial-of-service while it reboots (approx. 4 minutes). Vendor provided firmware 3.17B that removes the script.
proposal.cwe_quote: it was then confirmed that CGI scripts exist on the router that can be directly accessed with a web browser, without any authentication. In particular, the script "upgradeStatusReboot.cgi" executes the command to reboot the device.

AV.quote: allows unauthenticated attackers in the same local network to execute a CGI script which reboots the device.

AC.quote: An HTTP GET request to the CGI script "upgradeStatusReboot.cgi" will reboot the device:

PR.quote: can be directly accessed with a web browser, without any authentication.

UI.quote: An HTTP GET request to the CGI script "upgradeStatusReboot.cgi" will reboot the device:

S.quote: Executing this script renders the device unusable for the time of the reboot.

C.quote: No further information can be gathered or control over the devices be obtained.

I.quote: No further information can be gathered or control over the devices be obtained.

A.quote: In tests, it turned out that the device needs roughly four minutes to complete a reboot. As a consequence, any network using the device as a switch or router is not accessible during that time, too.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify the vendor-supplied firmware (3.17B) removes/protects the CGI endpoint; if not available, restrict access to the device management interface (network ACLs), and require authentication and authorization for any reboot/administrative CGI endpoints before patching.

evidence_quotes.claim: Unauthenticated local attackers can execute the CGI script to reboot the device
evidence_quotes.quote: allows unauthenticated attackers in the same local network to execute a CGI script which reboots the device.

evidence_quotes.claim: CGI scripts are accessible without authentication and include reboot script
evidence_quotes.quote: it was then confirmed that CGI scripts exist on the router that can be directly accessed with a web browser, without any authentication. In particular, the script "upgradeStatusReboot.cgi" executes the command to reboot the device.

evidence_quotes.claim: Contents of the reboot CGI script call reboot
PoC HTTP GET request that triggers reboot

evidence_quotes.quote: In tests, it turned out that the device needs roughly four minutes to complete a reboot. As a consequence, any network using the device as a switch or router is not accessible during that time, too.

Affected Versions: 3.12 and potentially later
Fixed Versions: 3.17B

evidence_quotes.claim: No data exfiltration or further control observed
evidence_quotes.quote: However, the attack is only possible if the attacker resides on the same network, and no further information can be gathered or control over the devices be obtained.
